rows.label: bf07100100_0030
rows.name:
This guy... he's not the
Rex we know anymore.

rows.label: bf07100100_0040
rows.name: He can go back to wherever he wants...

rows.label: bf07100100_0050
rows.name:
Everyone, perhaps that's
going a bit too far...

rows.label: bf07100100_0060
rows.name: Why don't we leave this to the ladies?

rows.label: bf07100100_0090
rows.name: Rex isn't acting like himself at all, mo.

rows.label: bf07100100_0100
rows.name: It's pathetic to give up after losing just once, mo.

rows.label: bf07100100_0160
rows.name: I don't want to see you like this, Rex, mo.

rows.label: bf07100100_0170
rows.name:
...Hana and Master are not a
real Blade-and-Driver pair, mo.

rows.label: bf07100100_0180
rows.name: That's why I admired you and the others so much, mo.

rows.label: bf07100100_0190
rows.name: You've worked sooo hard all this time, Rex, mo.

rows.label: bf07100100_0200
rows.name:
Because you keep trying, Rex,
Hana and Master can keep trying too, mo.

rows.label: bf07100100_0210
rows.name: You're my role model, Rex, mo.

rows.label: bf07100100_0220
rows.name: I want you to keep running on and on, mo.

rows.label: bf07100100_0230
rows.name: So... I don't want you to stop here, mo!

rows.label: bf07100100_0280
rows.name:
My old man's calling for you.
We're going to the palace.
